ME Boards Practice Hub

Choose a day or problem set to begin
Welcome! This is a self-contained practice quiz app for Mechanical Engineering board exam review, covering Math, PPE, and MD topics. Pick a Problem Set or Trivia Day below, answer at your own pace, and check your score and stats at the end. Your progress is saved automatically, so you can always pick up where you left off. Stuck on a question? Every item has built-in hints you can reveal step by step — so you can also use this to actually study, not just test yourself.

Pending Features / Things to be added

  • Diagrams/illustrations for applicable problems (e.g., geometry figures)
  • Full board exam simulator — randomized mix of all topics, up to 100 items each for Math and PPE
  • "Identify the Formula" mini-game — quick-fire clustered-distractor rounds to help retain and recognize which formula fits which problem type through repetition
